page.layout: One digitiser's cover sheet, no printed text block. Logo at top right, title information in the centre, a rule, multilingual access and licence notices below, and a Visual Library logo at bottom right.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet, not a printed page: the e-rara logo and banner, the www.e-rara.ch notices, the persistent link, the title information (Albinus, David, Disputatio philosophica de modo quo animus est unitus corpori, [Bernae], 1666, Universitätsbibliothek Bern) and the terms-of-use notices in German, English, French and Italian were all left out, as they are not printed on the book's page.
